---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible MSC failure
---

Describe the expected and actual behavior, including the exit status.

Include a minimized command and reproduction steps, MSC version/commit on both
hosts, kernel/compiler, storage type, flow/socket counts, and relevant `MSC_*`
settings. Attach redacted logs and say whether an independent checksum matched.

For suspected vulnerabilities, follow SECURITY.md rather than posting details here.
